name: ms_legal_split
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; echo "ad43c239fa2a47605c246748fee795a3070e0ad09f68cdc18eb0a880208bab07  babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py" | sha256sum -c -; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py
note: Moonshot legal-split follow-ups (experimenter 07:24Z, critic ref-0135), SOLO @ ref-0163: branch t4k2 (trunk, then c1/c2 --init_from trunk resume.pt) and split k3 s0-s2; each scored member gets score_trial, twin ref-0026 and pt_v2 dump (ref-0034 --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --check). Front ptv2bf back-fill when PTV2_BF is set. Copy to shared/babylm/moonshot/legal_split/<run>/. Last job twx: A2-formal twin ref-0026 on a2_base and a2_A2a (experimenter 11:13Z, critic ref-0201), after the legal-split cells.

jobs.name: ptv2bf
jobs.cmd: gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p babylm/moonshot && touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py && gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py; }; [ -f babylm/moonshot/__init__.py ] || touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py; if [ -n "${PTV2_BF:-}" ]; then for r in $PTV2_BF; do S=babylm/runs/_ptv2_bf/$r; mkdir -p $S && gsutil -m -q rsync -r __BUCKET__/ptv2_in/$r $S && CK= && { [ ! -f $S/dev_bpw_twin.json ] || CK="--check $S/dev_bpw_twin.json"; } && /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump $S/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out $S/dev_v2.npz $CK > $S/dump.log 2>&1 && echo "[ptv2] bf ok $r" || echo "[ptv2] bf FAILED $r"; rm -rf $S/hf; done; fi

jobs.name: ms_ls_br4k2_trunk
jobs.cmd: python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_moonshot_legal_branch_t4k2.json --only ms_ls_br4k2_trunk --device cuda; rc=$?; exit $rc

jobs.name: ms_ls_br4k2_c1
jobs.cmd: python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_moonshot_legal_branch_t4k2.json --only ms_ls_br4k2_c1 --device cuda; rc=$?; [ -f babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1 /opt/babylm || echo '[ls] score ms_ls_br4k2_c1 failed'; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] ms_ls_br4k2_c1 failed'; mkdir -p babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/pt_v2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/pt_v2/dev_v2.npz --check babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/ms_ls_br4k2_c1/pt_v2/dump.log 2>&1 || echo '[ptv2] ms_ls_br4k2_c1 failed'; }; exit $rc
